delta: +"""Scoped synthetic owner endpoints for Bot Manager tests."""

passes.C1: ran: traced default_installations→LegacyAdapter._verify health connection before token resolution. The shared per-case test fixture selects a freshly closed ephemeral loopback endpoint instead of the owner default8788.
passes.C2: ran: existing status/list/CLI/schema/learning/load/read-consistency contracts and assertions preserved. Explicit protocol-fixture endpoints still override the scoped default environment.
passes.C3: ran: original guarded process fixture run exposed28default8788attempts and refused them. Proposed source was qualified privately, then actual canonical40cases completed GREEN; no original assertions removed.
passes.S1: ran: no service, signing, credentials or external call authority added. Fixture chooses loopback from the OS ephemeral allocator; the inherited guard independently refuses occupied/unowned endpoints.
passes.S2: ran: reservation socket closes before yielding, and unittest.enterContext scopes environment restoration through teardown. The macOS held-non-listening-socket candidate timed out and was discarded before source application.
passes.S3: ran: host is literal127.0.0.1, port comes from a real ephemeral bind, and no arbitrary user/provider path becomes a fixture endpoint. Actual refusal/env-restoration regression passes.
passes.S4: ran: actual macOS/Python3.13 TCP semantics verified; no cross-platform or installed-owner qualification inferred. Native fixture/isolated child evidence remains separate from inherited hooks.
passes.S5: ran: guard failures remain visible as qualification failures and original CLI credential-canary assertions remain. No raw owner response/token/logging changes.
passes.P1: ran: one tiny socket reservation per affected case, no persistent listener/thread/process. Existing load latency assertions are retained and remain for full378integration.
passes.P2: ran: per-case context rather than a shared suite-wide endpoint. Existing actual concurrency/lease/process cleanup tests remain; no shared mutable fixture was hoisted.
